adqlQueries: SELECT sum(segments.userData.CarPrice_MIDC) AS "CarPrice_MIDC (Sum)" FROM transactions WHERE application = "Supercar-Trader" AND userExperience = "ERROR" AND transactionName = "/Supercar-Trader/sell.do"

SELECT sum(segments.userData.CarPrice_MIDC) AS "CarPrice_MIDC (Sum)" FROM transactions WHERE application = "Supercar-Trader" AND transactionName = "/Supercar-Trader/sell.do" AND userExperience IN ("NORMAL","SLOW","VERY_SLOW")

widgets.title: User Experience by Customer Transaction
adqlQueries: SELECT transactionName AS "Business Transaction", userExperience AS "User Experience" FROM transactions WHERE application = "Supercar-Trader" AND transactionName IN ("/Supercar-Trader/sell.do","/Supercar-Trader/home.do","/Supercar-Trader/car.do","/Supercar-Trader/cars.do","/Supercar-Trader/enquire.do","/Supercar-Trader/insurance.do","/Supercar-Trader/search.do","/Supercar-Trader/supercars.do","/Supercar-Trader/about.do") LIMIT 3, 10

widgets.title: Revenue by Car Model - $
adqlQueries: SELECT segments.userData.CarModel_MIDC AS "CarModel_MIDC", sum(segments.userData.CarPrice_MIDC) AS "CarPrice_MIDC (Sum)" FROM transactions WHERE application = "Supercar-Trader" AND transactionName IN ("/Supercar-Trader/sell.do","Sell.do.save") AND userExperience IN ("NORMAL","SLOW","VERY_SLOW") LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Revenue by Car Model - %
adqlQueries: SELECT segments.userData.CarModel_MIDC AS "CarModel_MIDC", sum(segments.userData.CarPrice_MIDC) AS "CarPrice_MIDC (Sum)" FROM transactions WHERE application = "Supercar-Trader" AND transactionName IN ("/Supercar-Trader/sell.do","Sell.do.save") AND userExperience IN ("NORMAL","SLOW","VERY_SLOW") LIMIT 10

SELECT funnel(segments.httpData.sessionId, transactionName = "/Supercar-Trader/home.do", transactionName = "/Supercar-Trader/sell.do", transactionName = "/Supercar-Trader/sell.do" AND segments.httpData.parameters.sellQuery_http = "save") AS "Home Page,Sell Car Form,Submit Car" FROM transactions WHERE application = "Supercar-Trader"

widgets.title: Revenue by Car Color - %
adqlQueries: SELECT segments.userData.CarColour_MIDC AS "CarColour_MIDC", sum(segments.userData.CarPrice_MIDC) AS "CarPrice_MIDC (Sum)" FROM transactions WHERE application = "Supercar-Trader" AND transactionName IN ("/Supercar-Trader/sell.do","Sell.do.save") AND userExperience IN ("NORMAL","SLOW","VERY_SLOW") LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Main Transactions Average Response Time (ms)
adqlQueries: SELECT transactionName AS "Business Transaction", avg(responseTime) AS "Response Time (ms) (Average)" FROM transactions WHERE application = "Supercar-Trader" AND transactionName IN ("/Supercar-Trader/sell.do","/Supercar-Trader/search.do","/Supercar-Trader/home.do") LIMIT 10

SELECT funnel(segments.httpData.sessionId, transactionName = "/Supercar-Trader/home.do", transactionName = "Sell.do", transactionName = "Sell.do.save") AS "Home Page,Sell Car Form,Submit Car" FROM transactions WHERE application = "Supercar-Trader"
